name: Task_9
description:
Generate a finite-temperature molecular dynamics trajectory of bulk Copper and estimate its potential-energy correlation time. Start with a conventional face-centered cubic (FCC) unit cell of Copper (a = 3.615 \u00c5) expanded into a 2 \u00d7 2 \u00d7 2 supercell. Use the MACE-MP-0 foundation model as the calculator. Conduct molecular dynamics simulations in the canonical (NVT) ensemble at 800 K, choosing and justifying the integration, thermostat, equilibration, production, and sampling settings. Retain exactly 200 uniformly spaced chronological production configurations, including both endpoints, with their instantaneous total potential energies.

Use the supplied 32-atom cell and MACE-MP-0 teacher with float64 precision and no dispersion. Initialize velocities at 800 K with a recorded seed, remove center-of-mass momentum, and preserve the fixed cell, atoms, and velocities from equilibration into production. Assess thermal settling and retain the calculation.

Use a timestep of at most 2 fs and retain at least 16 equilibration samples per run. Production duration is flexible; a resolved correlation estimate requires at least 10 correlation times of production and consistency across trajectory windows; supported bounds are accepted.
